locale.custom_language_code_tooltip: Language codes in OCL use the syntax "en" or "en-GB" in accordance with ISO 639-1, with an optional 2-letter country code following BCP47. OCL allows language codes in other formats, however these codes may limit certain features or be incompatible with client systems, like OpenMRS. Letters and "-" are allowed for language codes.
locale.iso_639_1_support_note: OCL's data model supports ISO-639-1 (two digit) codes as standard. Consider updating.

privacy_consent.banner_text: We would like to use Hotjar heatmaps to see where people click and scroll in the Mapper, so we can improve it. What you type and the content you upload are masked. Nothing is collected unless you accept.
privacy_consent.essential_text: Sign-in, your language and this choice. The Mapper needs them to work.
privacy_consent.heatmaps_text: Clicks, taps, mouse movement and scrolling on Mapper pages, and a snapshot of the page layout (not video), so we can see what to improve. What you type and the content you upload are masked before anything leaves your browser.
privacy_consent.reload_notice: Hotjar is already running on this page. Saving reloads the page to stop it; your project is saved automatically.
